facts.text: Under Randolph College's TAKE2 curriculum, students take only two courses at a time in seven-week sessions, with no classes held on Wednesdays.

sources.title: TAKE2: One-of-a-kind academic model will better meet the needs of today's students - Randolph College News and Events
sources.quote: program that has students taking two classes at a time for seven-week sessions. Each semester will consist of two of these sessions separated by a one-week break.

sources.title: TAKE2: One-of-a-kind academic model will better meet the needs of today's students - Randolph College News and Events
sources.quote: Courses will go from three-credit to four-credit and will meet up to four times a week, depending on the course. No classes will be held on Wednesdays.
